scope: Fourteen-case diagnostic, not a full-suite or Word-reference score

metric.blockInsertion: declared insertion outcomes require typed success, error, version change and undo availability
metric.caseScore: 100 when every applicable mandatory check passes, otherwise 0
metric.columnReview: v2 column edits require the declared typed registry count/status before resolution, successful public resolution and an empty final registry
metric.hyperlinkTargets: declared hyperlink-target assertions require every main-document hyperlink to resolve to one external relationship, and the set of their targets to equal the declared strings as written
metric.libreofficeEligibility: a LibreOffice comparison applies only when the authored redline passes it
metric.paragraphRewrite: public untracked whole-paragraph rewrites must preserve exact declared native content-control subtrees as well as independent semantic views
metric.revisionOwnership: account-configured edits require declared before/after public name status, exact raw reviewer identities and retained insertion/deletion markup, in addition to independent round trips
metric.revisionRegistry: declared table operations must report the public registry count and match independent resolved table assertions
metric.semanticPreflight: declared identity cases must report zero changes at raw limits with and without the package supplement
metric.spanEditing: public span editing must preserve text and inline-marker order through both independent revision resolvers
metric.suiteScore: mean of category means over every required case
metric.validity: no OpenXmlValidator finding (id, part, description) occurs more often than in any input, and the output opens: a Package_Open finding in the output always fails, whatever the inputs did

capture.renderer: WmlToHtmlConverter.ConvertToHtml default flow for both saved outputs
capture.method: Offline Chromium, installed fonts, 1200x720 viewport, full-page PNG
